styleDefinitions.baseline: Frozen local baseline selects bids and cards.
styleDefinitions.conservative: Synthetic stress style: baseline bid minus one, then lowest legal rank.
styleDefinitions.assertive: Synthetic stress style: baseline bid plus one, then highest legal rank.

manifest.pairing: For each original deal seed and style, compare candidate and reference on the same deck, dealer and assessed competitor. The seed, not a hand row, is the independent deal group.
limitations: This is a deterministic local policy comparison against three synthetic styles, not human or expert play.
The same deal seeds appear in multiple styles and arms; those rows are correlated.
Only one complete hand per arm is played from zero score and bags. Match outcomes and carryover effects are not measured here.
No independently accepted action labels are used; score differences alone cannot certify advice quality.
No Jev request, provider fallback, calibration or user learning is measured.
